reason: A local agent observability plugin that records session execution traces and provides a loopback-only viewer for timings, events, failures, token usage, and related diagnostics.

summaries.zh: 记录智能体会话、模型步骤和工具调用的本地 JSONL 追踪数据，并通过仅限本机访问的查看器展示执行时序与诊断信息。
summaries.en: Records local JSONL traces for agent sessions, model steps, and tool calls, then presents timing and diagnostic details in a loopback-only viewer.

capabilities: Records agent session, model, tool, timing, outcome, and token usage events to local JSONL files
Provides a local read-only trace viewer over loopback HTTP
Can optionally capture prompts, replies, tool arguments, and tool results with redaction and truncation
Can delete old regular trace files when retention is explicitly configured
